signatures.rule: Every canvas carries the ProductTank lockup (wordmark + city + strapline), White or Midnight, left-aligned in the top-left or bottom-left corner
The strapline reads exactly 'a Mind the Product meetup', never reworded, never translated
The ground is Bold Cyan (social default) or Midnight (stories, closing slides); Markup Yellow and Purple are never grounds
Headlines are sentence case, Montserrat Bold (Cera Pro Bold when licensed), White on Bold Cyan or Midnight, at the display size of the format
The key word of an announcement sits on one yellow Markup box in Midnight text; one markup gesture per canvas
A venn (one full circle, one target, one of donut/polo/eye/ring) or one or two Venniverse shapes anchor the composition; never two targets
Facts (date, time, venue) sit in one facts row with the month spelled out, above or beside the headline, never buried in body copy
Subject photography is a cut-out that bleeds off at least one edge and sits over the venn; textural photography is full-bleed with the tritone wash
Every canvas declares its format and archetype on the root and sets data-render-ready only after fonts have loaded

donts: Do not change the colour of the logo or lockup: Midnight or White only (Brand Guide 2.2, 2.3)
Do not add text, a drop shadow, a reflection, an outline, a rotation, a distortion or a venn to the logo, and never retype it (2.2)
Do not place the lockup centred or on the right; never smaller than 80 px wide; keep clear space equal to the height of the P (2.3)
Do not use Markup Yellow as a background field or as the primary colour of a composition; it is for markup gestures, CTAs and tags only (4.2, 6.5)
Do not set coloured text: text is White or Midnight (Black on a markup is allowed); no gradient text, no cyan text on cyan (6.1)
Do not use more than one target circle; do not mask photographs with the venn; do not combine only low-contrast colours (5.4)
Do not stack the text highlight; it is one row of two related facts in bold caps (6.1)
No UPPER CASE or Capitalised Headings: headings are sentence case; caps live only in the label pill and the text highlight (3.2)

No legacy palette: the pre-2024 cyan set (#009EE3, #192844, #92EAFF, #DDEEEE, #007EB6, #EFF6F7, #8B98A7, #FA6969) and the 2023 slide theme (#7E57FF, #FDAF53, #092232, #442A30, #EDFE37, #C4BFB2) are forbidden (DEC-003)
No 'PM' or 'PMs': the audience is product people; brand names are spelled Mind the Product and ProductTank (1.3)
No invented facts: dates, venues, speaker names, sponsor names and numbers come from the brief or BRAND-FACTS §9, or the slot stays typed (DEC-006)
No URLs baked into a canvas: the post or the Meetup page carries the link (playbook)
No em dashes, no lorem ipsum, no glassmorphism or backdrop blur, no gradients except the tritone photo wash (Midnight > Bold Cyan > Zingy Cyan)
No AI-default typefaces (Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Space Grotesk, Arial as a display face) and no script or brush lettering
Do not reuse the photography inside the Figma reference renders; it is Mind the Product's imagery, not this community's (DEC-007)

decisions.decision: The city lockup is ProductTank Brussels (MTP's official file). The community is named 'ProductTank Belgium' in copy, never as a lockup. DEPRECATED 2026-09-07 evening: the copy clause is replaced by DEC-012 (always "ProductTank Brussels").
decisions.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-09-07: keep the Brussels logo and say 'ProductTank Belgium' in the text. No official Belgium file exists; the guide sets city names in Cera Pro Regular.

decisions.decision: Montserrat (OFL, variable) is the shipped face. Cera Pro is a licensed drop-in: add the woff2 files, edit fonts[] and typography families, re-derive.
decisions.rationale: Brand Guide 3.1 names Montserrat as the organiser alternative and MTP's own 2026 organiser templates say 'Please use Montserrat ONLY'. Owner ruling 2026-09-07: Montserrat at the closest optical size (per-format headline sizes in base.css).

decisions.decision: The pre-2024 cyan palette and the 2023 slide-template theme are forbidden hexes.
decisions.rationale: Both still exist in the 2026 resources file and in the master deck; Brand Guide 4.2 unified everything under the 2024 palette.

decisions.decision: Formats use MTP's own template sizes where a reference exists; the square ships at 1080x1080 (source 1000x1000); slides are 1920x1080 HTML with PNG, PDF and image-PPTX export.
decisions.rationale: Current platform sizes; deterministic browser rendering; the official Google Slides template stays the editable source.

decisions.decision: Figma renders are tear-down and review references only. A pixel-diff reference is armed solely from a render the owner approved (tools/arm-reference.mjs), never self-seeded.
decisions.rationale: The renders were set in Cera Pro; comparing Montserrat output to them measures the font, not the drift. CONTRACT provenance rule and a sibling skill's armed-reference policy.

decisions.decision: No community fact is invented. Announcements must carry 'Free to attend' and a Meetup mention; every date spells out the month.
decisions.rationale: MTP organiser rules (free events, registration on Meetup.com) and Brand Guide 1.3; the standing zero-facts rule.

decisions.decision: Subject photos are cut-outs bleeding off an edge over a venn; textural photos are full-bleed with the tritone wash; the venn never masks a photo; MTP's reference photography is never reused.
decisions.rationale: Brand Guide 5.4 and 6.2; the reference imagery is not this community's to redistribute.

decisions.decision: Markup Yellow is #ECF023 (Brand Guide 4.1). #EBEF23 as drawn in the file's markup shapes is the same colour, not a second token. Venn circles and markup strokes are authored to the guide's recipe until the official SVGs arrive in Figma pass 2. WITHDRAWN 2026-09-07 evening: the official component SVGs arrived in Figma pass 2 (DEC-009).
decisions.rationale: One token per colour; the API cap blocked the component exports on 2026-09-07.

decisions.decision: The six venn circles and the markup gestures are MTP's official component exports (Figma pass 2 via the owner's copy of the file), converted to currentColor. The hand-drawn box behind a word stays a derived mask (no official component exists for it). Derived files are kept as *.derived.svg for the record.
decisions.rationale: Captured assets beat derived ones (imagery policy Tier 1).

decisions.decision: Black #060119 joins the neutrals as a ground for slides and event-promo canvases and as the guide's body-text colour; Bold Cyan stays the social default, Midnight the story ground.
decisions.rationale: MTP's 2026 organiser slide template and the 1200x675 social template use #060119 as their ground (432 and 25 fills); the Brand Guide's own body text is #060119.

decisions.decision: The speaker element is a circular photo with three lines: name (bold), role, '@ Company'. The event-promo canvas is the organiser template: dark ground, lockup top-left, date|time highlight, title, location line, a white sponsor-logo box, speakers or a venn on the right.
decisions.rationale: MTP's organiser templates (Assets/Social Templates 2024, Slide Template 2026) use exactly this element on every speaker and WPD canvas.

decisions.decision: The community is always written 'ProductTank Brussels', in copy as in the lockup. 'ProductTank Belgium' is never written on a canvas, in a caption or on a slide. DEPRECATED 2026-09-15: replaced by DEC-013 (always "ProductTank Belgium").
decisions.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-09-07 evening: 'Let's always write Brussels not Belgium.' Matches the official lockup and MTP's one-city naming.

decisions.decision: The community is 'ProductTank Belgium', in the lockup as in copy. The lockup is assets/logo/producttank-belgium-{midnight,white}.svg: the ProductTank wordmark and the strapline are the untouched outlines from Mind the Product's Brussels file; the word 'Belgium' is set in Montserrat (variable, wght 440) and outlined, matched to the Brussels glyphs on cap height (41.58 px in the 392x155 viewBox), baseline (y 106), left edge (x 5.73) and stem width (4.8 px against 4.85). 'ProductTank Brussels' is never written on a canvas, in a caption or on a slide; a venue address may still say Brussels. The Brussels file stays in assets/logo as Mind the Product's official reference.
decisions.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-09-15: 'I need a logo that says ProductTank Belgium and this is how we will call it from now on instead of ProductTank Brussels.' No official Belgium file exists in MTP's logo repository, so the city line is set in the organiser face (DEC-002) at the closest optical weight to the Cera Pro Regular original; ask MTP's regional coordinator for an official file and drop it in when it exists.

policy: Tier 1: captured assets first. Lockups from assets/logo ( or inline
Tier 2: derived compositions declared with data-derived-art: venn circles per Brand Guide 5.2 (full, donut, polo, eye, target, ring), Venniverse shapes, markup strokes per 6.5.

Photography: subject cut-outs bleed off an edge and sit over the venn; textural photography is full-bleed with the Midnight > Bold Cyan > Zingy Cyan tritone wash; supplied by the brief (event photos, speaker headshots with consent), never taken from the Figma reference renders.
No abstract motif outside the venn, Venniverse and markup families; no stock illustration; icons are Feather/Lucide outlines at 3 px stroke when needed.
